## About
Snelson Services is a repair and maintenance shop on Wiggins St in Houston. We work on industrial trucks, and we carry parts too.
Customers have given us a 4.3 rating from 61 reviews on Google. One reviewer called our crew true craftsman mechanics, and another said we keep downtime to a minimum and really care about the customer.
We're open Monday through Friday, early in the morning until mid afternoon. Call ahead with your questions and we'll point you to the right person.

## Services
- Service for industrial trucks: Service work for industrial trucks, done by mechanics who know them well.
- Repair and maintenance: Routine maintenance and repairs to keep your vehicle running.
- Bendix and Haldex parts: We carry parts, including Bendix and Haldex. One reviewer mentioned Sam can help you find what you need.
